dedupe_keys.name: world bank multi tier framework energy access survey kenya 2016 2018 household and institution microdata

description: This Microdata Library entry holds the Kenya household survey of the World Bank's Multi-Tier Framework for measuring energy access, run by the Energy Sector Management Assistance Program in 2016 to 2018. The sample is 3,300 households, split evenly between electrified and non-electrified homes and between urban and rural areas, with seven questionnaires that also cover schools, health centres, places of worship, government offices, community focus groups and mini-grid developers. Topics include electricity supply from the grid, mini-grids, generators and solar devices, willingness to pay for a connection, lighting and cooking fuels, cookstoves, household assets, time use, health impacts and street lighting. Access: version 2, an anonymised dataset without the GPS variables of version 1, free to download under public-use terms (licence: citation required, (c) World Bank), with documentation in PDF and DDI/XML. Coverage is national. Caveats: only the metadata page was read, not the data files, and the household energy data are for the 2016 to 2018 period. It suits capacity planning and energy access studies of household electricity service, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
